Observed bird features, including beaks and feet.
Described a crow’s beak as pointed and a duck’s beak as flat.
Linked a kingfisher’s long, pointed beak with catching fish.
Explained that webbed feet help a duck push through water while swimming.
Teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised observing beak and foot shapes and linking each feature to how a bird feeds or moves. Atharv explained that a kingfisher’s pointed beak helps catch fish and that webbed feet help a duck swim. They first grouped both birds’ feet together, then later explained the duck’s webbed feet correctly. At home, look at one bird or animal together and name one feature and what it helps the animal do.
